hypothesis: Can a development-supervised, native three-weight retention scorer predict which graph relations to preserve in a seven-edge store under 12-relation overload, improving unseen compositional queries versus equal-capacity FIFO and LRU?
learnable_native_component: Three SGD-fitted real-valued logistic weights on observed public exposure count and time of insertion (plus intercept). Supervision in development uses future query relevance. Sealed inference receives only current/past exposures/timestamps and no future target labels. Preserves unchanged native learned 6-param join.
task: 12 distinct public graph facts in variable insertion order; capacity fixed at seven; at observation time 6, public rehearsal updates LRU for existing high-exposure edges; answer 2-hop and novel 4-hop graph questions, then restore from checkpoint and retry. 24 sealed seeds×4 graph families.
controls: Same frozen six-weight native relation join and lexical admission without external LLM
All arms use seven relation edges and same public facts in same order
Fixed learned scorer training on development only; no leak of future sealed query targets into inference
FIFO insertion age and LRU publicly observed recency baselines; original exact graph oracle is computationally unbounded and separately disclosed
Preserve per-family accuracy, learned scorer multiplies, join-work counters, wall time, negative conditions, record all 96 cases
Only one original sealed first-use, artifact upload before rubric, full Go regression and separate no-replay archive audit
No FORGE R32/R33, accepted refs, controller, CKB/KTRADE, merges or production
rubric: LEARNED_BOUNDED_RETENTION_TRANSFER iff learned four-hop >=0.60, delta vs FIFO >=0.15 and vs LRU >=0.10, with no family worse than LRU by >0.20. PARTIAL_RETENTION_GAIN_WITH_GENERALIZATION_COST iff learned FIFO gain >=0.10 but full criteria fail. Otherwise NO_TRANSFERABLE_LEARNED_RETENTION_GAIN. Never claim learned relational storage/search, AGI, RSI or NCI01 full acceptance.
